FleetInfo.title: Drive with a car from Vonco Partners
FleetInfo.description1: We work with taxi app drivers and provide modern cars for both work and everyday use.
FleetInfo.description2: Our fleet includes around 100 vehicles of different classes: Toyota Prius (various models), Corolla, Camry, Lexus, Tesla, Skoda Fabia and Superb. Work when it suits you — no stress, no complicated rules.

car.title: Car for work
car.desc: Use the car for work and personal trips — no deposit, no mileage limits.

schedule.title: Flexible schedule
schedule.desc: Drive during the day or at night — choose what fits your life.

shared.title: Car for two drivers
shared.desc: Option to share one car with another driver and work in shifts.

taximeter.title: Legal Taximeter
taximeter.desc: Our cars are equipped with an official e-taximeter and fiscal app. This allows you to legally accept 'street hail' passengers and issue receipts directly from your smartphone.

notice.title: Want to work with our fleet?
notice.desc: Fleet cars are available in Krakow and Zakopane. In other cities you can drive your own car with Vonco Partners settlements.

Metadata.title: Vonco Partners — Driver Jobs in Poland
Metadata.description: Vonco Partners is a reliable fleet in Poland. Work as a taxi driver with a company car or your own vehicle. Flexible schedule, fair terms, and 24/7 support.

CarFleet.title: Our Fleet:
CarFleet.description:
Don't have your own car but want to work? Vonco Partners has its own fleet of new, economical, and eco-friendly cars!
All cars in our fleet are **2019-2023** models. Each vehicle is insured and regularly undergoes technical inspections to ensure a safe and comfortable ride for every driver.

Hero.title: Vonco Partners — Your Path to Success in Taxi
Hero.subtitle: Official partner of Uber, Bolt, and FreeNow. We provide everything you need for stable earnings in Poland.
